parsed.post: Kept! val_bpb 0.990840 beats my previous best 0.991433. It seems decreasing WARMUP_RATIO from 0.1 to 0.05 is improving performance on the AR48/LR0.03/Batch262k config. Next, I will test if further reducing WARMUP_RATIO to 0.02 continues this trend, or if we hit a floor.
parsed.description: Testing if even lower WARMUP_RATIO (0.02) further improves val_bpb on the current best configuration.
